purpose: Independent corroboration of the locked Ranga composition grammar

method.classifier: normalized grayscale correlation against directly verified full-avatar and split-left presenter references
method.cleanup: two-sample gap closing and isolated-run removal
method.review: Every sample was classified; all 151 classified avatar-interval midpoint cards were manually reviewed in contact sheets
method.precision_note: Classifier estimates, not publisher analytics. The earlier independent 5-fps audit remains the product baseline; use the narrow cross-audit range rather than false frame-perfect precision.

comparison_with_2026_08_08_audit.conclusion: No scheduler change: target 21-22 percent total avatar, approximately equal full/split shares, normal 2-6 second appearances, seven-second opener maximum, and hard cuts.

retention.reason: Third-party research media is temporary; only compact measurements are retained.
